note: City of Neligh campground in Riverside Park, in town by the Elkhorn River: one long row of pedestals on open grass along the west side of the park drive, between the ballfields and a small creek; grass pads, some need leveling, pull-through options. The river is ~200 m west beyond the ballfields and its treeline, not in view. Restrooms with showers. Tents $5. --Claude
summary: The City of Neligh's camping page confirms Riverside Park RV pads at $20 a day, first come first served, with electric and water, sewage dump access and Wi-Fi; written. Imagery puts the pedestal row on open grass beside the park drive with the Elkhorn ~200 m west beyond ballfields and a riparian treeline (only a small creek east of the drive): not waterfront stands. The review-sourced 36-ft max length is cleared.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront CONFIRMED (re-audited both ways): the pedestal row runs N-S on open grass west of the park's main drive, ~42.1227-42.1242 N. The Elkhorn River (braided, ~60-100 m wide) is ~180-220 m west, behind two ballfields, a park road and a continuous riverbank treeline; it is not in view. East of the drive is only a narrow wooded creek (a few metres wide), well under riverfront width and behind the road.
SITE COUNT 32 (derived) left: imagery shows ~20+ pedestals in the row plus a few more south by the shelter, so it is plausible but unconfirmed; the city page gives no count.
max_rig_ft 36 (derived from camper reviews) cleared to null; open grass pull-in pads with no length limit, so a 23-ft rig is not in doubt.
ELECTRIC 50 (derived from note '15/30/50-amp') left: the city says only 'Electric and water hookups'.
